changelog: • Reused a per-thread compression `buffer` instead of `reallocating` on every call, reducing `memory` pressure and fragmentation
• **Native Stub Architecture:** Native stub now matches application bitness (`AnyCPU → x64 on 64-bit systems`)
• **Smarter Elevation Handling:** Detects admin intent directly from `payload` code
• **Command-Line Forwarding:** Native loader now forwards `command-line` arguments to the payload
• **Runtime Reliability:** Reduced `post-packing` runtime failures caused by missing `config/manifest`
• **UAC Manifest Preservation:** Embedded UAC manifest is preserved, with `requireAdministrator` applied when required
• **Assembly Metadata Compatibility:** `Assembly.GetEntryAssembly()` and `Assembly.Location` no longer return null/empty under in-memory load
